title: Haim Eshed's galactic federation and Mars program claims

tellings.quote: His name is Heim Esed. He said that there's a galactic federation and there's a space program involving people on Mars.

plain: A man in Israel named Haim Eshed has said that there is a galactic federation, a kind of alliance of beings beyond Earth, and that a space programme exists that involves people living on Mars. Michels brings this up himself on the show and credits it to Eshed and to Eshed's book, which he does not name. If true, it would mean contact with other worlds and a human presence on Mars are already happening out of public view.
